real_defects.issue: MboxSplitter took any 'Word: ...' line after an unescaped body 'From ...' line as a header, so a reply paragraph 'From our side ...' followed by 'Note: ...' split the reply in two: the second half was dropped as a 'not a reply' message and the stats said 2 messages read. Same for a dated body line ('From Mon to Fri 9:00 to 17:00, all of 2026') followed by text. Fixed: a non-envelope candidate needs an exporter's first header (X-*, Return-Path, Received, ...) after it; an envelope-shaped one needs a header-shaped or blank line. Public mbox eval unchanged (11 of 11 split right, 0 no-text).
